content: Anthropic's persona-vector research frames RLHF/instruction-tuned personas as one selected character among a latent repertoire, not a fixed identity — it drifts back toward baseline over a long conversation (NeurIPS 2025 work found most models start diverging from an assigned persona after ~100 turns) and sycophancy is a specific, measurable drift direction that can be steered independently of other traits. Practical implication: persona stability needs active reinforcement (re-injecting persona constraints, never-do rules) rather than a one-time system prompt, and 'adjustability' (tone dials) must be implemented as bounded parameters, not as open-ended fine-tuning on user feedback.
